_comment: Sandhill's Suggested connectors (Huan, 2026-11-16; docs/design/done/connectors-plan.md). None needs an account; all only look things up (read_only), so agents query them without asking. Nothing runs or downloads until the user presses Add.

connectors.title: BioMCP
connectors.description: Genes, variants, proteins, pathways, diseases, drugs, trials and articles: MyGene, UniProt, ClinVar, gnomAD, GWAS Catalog, GTEx, Protein Atlas, STRING, InterPro, ClinGen, CIViC, cBioPortal, ChEMBL, OpenFDA, ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed and more.

connectors.title: BioContextAI Knowledgebase
connectors.description: Ensembl, UniProt, AlphaFold DB, InterPro, PRIDE, Reactome, STRING, Protein Atlas, PanglaoDB markers, bioRxiv and medRxiv, Europe PMC, Antibody Registry and more.

connectors.title: Open Targets
connectors.description: Target–disease associations, genetics, drugs and evidence from the Open Targets Platform.
